Sales Executive
description:
**About Teson** 




 Teson is a product company building practical software for businesses that run on volume and deadlines.
 



 We focus on tools that remove operational friction, protect what a business creates, and get work to the customer faster.
 



 We work across our own products and with client businesses that need software built around how they actually operate.
 



 We are growing, and we are building our sales function now.
 



  





**The Role** 



* This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role located in Thane.
* Own the complete sales cycle.
* From first conversation to signed customer to smooth onboarding.
* You will work closely with leadership to shape how we sell.



  





 What You Will Do
 


* Own and manage the sales pipeline in our CRM.
* Log every customer interaction, the same day.
* Nurture leads consistently until they convert.
* Research each prospect's business before every meeting.
* Visit client sites where the opportunity needs it.
* Run discovery\-led meetings that uncover the real problem.
* Position the right Teson solution against that problem.
* Build and tailor sales presentations for each customer segment.
* Negotiate and close within our pricing framework.
* Act as the bridge between customers and our operations team.
* Communicate professionally over email, calls, and WhatsApp.
* Own a monthly target and report on it honestly.



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* **Experience:**
* 2 to 5 years in B2B sales. SaaS or software preferred.
* A track record of carrying and hitting a target.
* Comfort working with a CRM every day.
* **Skills:**
* Consultative discovery. You find the problem behind the problem.
* Business storytelling. You sell outcomes, not features.
* Presentation building. You can create your own decks.
* Negotiation. You hold value without resorting to discounts.
* Clear, professional written and spoken communication.
* Strong self\-management. You plan your own week.
* **Who You Are**
* You see yourself as an advisor to the customer, not a vendor.
* You take ownership of your number.
* You are disciplined about follow\-up.
* You are curious about how other businesses run.
* You handle rejection without losing momentum.
* You report your pipeline honestly, always.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* **Bonus**
* Experience selling to small and mid\-sized businesses.
* Exposure to selling both products and custom software services.



  





**What We Offer** 



* ﻿CTC of ₹3\.6 LPA to ₹6\.2 LPA, based on the competencies you bring.
* Performance incentive on closures, over and above the fixed CTC.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how we sell.
* Products and services our customers genuinely need.
* Clear growth path as the team scales.

title: Sales Management Trainee
description:
**Company Description** 
 SARUH is an AI\-powered restaurant intelligence platform that helps restaurants make smarter, data\-driven decisions. Designed for restaurant owners, operators, and multi\-outlet brands, SARUH converts complex operational data into clear, actionable insights. The platform focuses on key areas such as sales performance, profitability, marketing effectiveness, customer reviews, and day\-to\-day operations. By centralizing insights, SARUH enables teams to optimize processes, improve guest experiences, and drive sustainable growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales Management Trainee at Saruh is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Thane. This role involves learning and supporting the end\-to\-end sales cycle, including lead qualification, product demonstrations, and follow\-ups with prospective restaurant clients. The trainee will assist in managing customer accounts, respond to client inquiries, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and ongoing service. Daily tasks include maintaining accurate sales records, preparing basic reports, shadowing senior sales team members, and participating in training sessions to build strong product and industry knowledge. The role is designed to develop the trainee into a capable sales professional who can independently handle client relationships and contribute to revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with restaurant stakeholders and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess foundational Sales and Account Management skills to support lead handling, client follow\-ups, and relationship building.
* Candidates should possess Training\-related skills, including the ability to learn quickly, apply feedback, and participate actively in coaching sessions.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
* Comfort with technology and data\-driven tools; experience or interest in SaaS or hospitality/restaurant solutions is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Thane and collaborate in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Preferred educational background in Business, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 RATNAAFIN Capital is one of India’s fastest\-growing Non\-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), holding a CRISIL A\+ rating and backed by the diversified Ratnamani Sanghvi family group with interests across engineering, pharmaceuticals, real estate, and finance. The organization focuses on empowering entrepreneurs and MSMEs by providing fast, transparent, and tailored financial solutions aligned with each business’s unique needs. RATNAAFIN combines deep industry knowledge with speed of execution to unlock working capital, support expansion plans, and deliver the right capital at the right time. More than a lender, the company positions itself as a long\-term growth partner, committed to listening, solving, and supporting clients as they scale. Business owners across India choose RATNAAFIN to grow with confidence and turn ambition into measurable outcomes.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Sales Manager role based in Vasai, offered in a hybrid model that combines on\-site work with some flexibility to work from home. The Sales Manager will be responsible for leading and managing sales activities, including identifying and acquiring new MSME clients, nurturing existing relationships, and promoting RATNAAFIN’s financial products and solutions. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing and executing sales strategies, conducting client meetings and presentations, analyzing customer needs, and recommending appropriate lending and financial solutions. The role also involves managing a sales pipeline, monitoring performance against targets, preparing sales reports, and collaborating with credit, operations, and marketing teams to ensure seamless service delivery. The Sales Manager will be expected to uphold high standards of ethics, customer service, and regulatory compliance while driving business growth.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Proven experience in sales or business development, preferably in NBFCs, banking, or financial services, with a strong track record of achieving revenue and growth targets.
* Strong client relationship management skills, including the ability to build trust with MSME business owners, understand their financial needs, and provide suitable solutions.
* Knowledge of lending products, working capital finance, SME/ MSME financing, and basic credit assessment concepts, with an understanding of market trends in the sector.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively with internal teams.
* Ability to analyze sales data, prepare reports, and use CRM or sales management tools to track leads, opportunities, and performance metrics.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple client engagements, and work effectively in a hybrid environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant professional certifications in sales or finance are an advantage.

title: Sales Associate
description:
**Company Description** 




 Barouliya Fragrancia Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian industrial fragrance manufacturer delivering high\-performance, cost\-effective fragrance solutions for home care, fabric care, air care, personal care, beauty care, and fine fragrance products. Built on a five\-generation legacy of perfumery and led by Rajesh Barouliya, the company combines traditional craftsmanship with modern fragrance science. Barouliya Fragrancia is known for precise fragrance matching, superior raw material sourcing, and stringent quality control supported by advanced testing. A key strength is its encapsulated (ENCAP) fragrance technology, which offers controlled release and extended fragrance longevity to improve product performance. With a zero\-waste mindset and sustainable sourcing practices, the company serves enterprises across India and global markets as a reliable, value\-driven fragrance partner.
 



**Role Description** 




 The Sales Executive role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Thane. This role involves identifying and qualifying potential clients in home care, fabric care, air care, personal care, beauty care, and fine fragrance segments, and building a strong sales pipeline. The Sales Executive will conduct client meetings, present fragrance solutions and ENCAP technology benefits, prepare proposals, negotiate pricing and contract terms, and close deals in line with company targets. The role includes maintaining ongoing relationships with existing customers, coordinating with the R\&D and production teams for custom fragrance requirements, and ensuring timely order execution and after\-sales support. The Sales Executive will also track market trends, gather competitive intelligence, prepare sales reports, and contribute to sales strategies that drive revenue growth and brand visibility.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Proven skills in B2B sales, client relationship management, lead generation, and account management within FMCG, fragrance, or allied industries.
* Ability to understand and communicate technical product features, including fragrance applications and encapsulation technology, in clear business terms.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to engage decision\-makers and influence purchasing decisions.
* Experience in market research, competitor analysis, and developing sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets.
* Comfort with CRM tools, basic MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and reporting of sales metrics and forecasts.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented approach with strong time management, planning, and organizational skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Chemistry, or a related field; relevant professional experience in fragrances, chemicals, or FMCG is highly preferred.
* Willingness to travel Pan India and to client locations as required.

 Full\-time

 Fixed Salary \+ Attractive Performance\-Based Incentives
 



  





**About the Opportunity** 




 One of our clients operating in the
 **premium agricultural land and managed plantation sector** 
 is looking for a proactive and customer\-focused Business Development Executive.
 



 The selected candidate will be responsible for managing property enquiries, qualifying prospects, conducting follow\-ups, scheduling meetings and site visits, and supporting the sales team throughout the customer journey.
 



  





**Key ResponsibilitiesLead Management and Qualification** 



* Handle enquiries and leads generated through online advertising campaigns, referrals and other marketing activities.
* Contact new leads promptly through phone calls, WhatsApp, email and online meetings.
* Understand each prospect’s property requirements, budget, preferred location and investment objectives.
* Qualify prospects based on their interest, requirements and expected purchasing timeline.
* Maintain regular and professional follow\-ups with every assigned lead.



  





**Client Communication and Sales Support** 



* Introduce prospects to the company’s agricultural land and managed plantation projects.
* Share approved project information, presentations, brochures, videos and pricing details.
* Explain project features,, location advantages, available land options and key features clearly.
* Address initial customer questions and coordinate detailed discussions with senior sales executives when required.
* Build trust and maintain positive relationships with prospective buyers.

* Schedule client meetings, online presentations and property site visits.
* Coordinate with the sales and project teams to ensure a smooth site\- experience.
* Confirm appointments and send reminders and relevant information to prospects.

* Support senior sales executives during presentations, negotiations and deal closures.

* Manage WhatsApp Business communication and approved WhatsApp campaigns.
* Maintain organised lead databases and customer communication records.
* Update all calls, follow\-ups, meetings and site visits in the CRM.
* Track leads through different stages of the sales pipeline.
* Prepare daily activity updates and weekly lead\-status reports.
* Coordinate with the marketing team and share feedback on campaign responses and lead quality.

* Achieve assigned targets for lead response, qualified prospects, meetings and site visits.
* Ensure that no qualified lead is missed due to delayed communication or follow\-up.
* Support the sales team in improving conversions from enquiry to meeting, site visit and booking.
